known_issues.check: CHECKED FOR BUT NEVER USED AS EVIDENCE
known_issues.reason: It is used, as (no …) in 'Diagnose possible TB before starting ART' (Q1 = No). The gate's NO_RE only recognises the rendered (no …) form when the finding has no qualifier: VHA renders the No qualifier before the Known present qualifier, so the regex misses it. Faithful encoding kept.

judgment_calls.decision: HIV infection (clinical_finding) triggers both check_for tasks and the priority rule
judgment_calls.alternatives: active_condition HIV (would need a probable HIV rule); adding an 'on ART' exclusion (no concept for ART-naive)

judgment_calls.decision: Urgent, because the page says 'refer same day'
judgment_calls.alternatives: Very urgent/Emergency for seizure etc. as their global warning signs carry; page does not escalate

judgment_calls.decision: Encode 'Exclude TB' as possible Tuberculosis for HIV + not known TB + any listed symptom
CD4, CrAg branches and their downstream nodes (jaundice/meningitis/acute illness, TB timing) not encoded
